title: Civil Engineers
description: Perform engineering duties in planning, designing, and overseeing construction and maintenance of building structures and facilities, such as roads, railroads, airports, bridges, harbors, channels, dams, irrigation projects, pipelines, power plants, and water and sewage systems.

tasks.text: Direct engineering activities, ensuring compliance with environmental, safety, or other governmental regulations.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Compliance coordination needs human accountability and site action

dwas.name: Coordinate safety or regulatory compliance activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Manage and direct the construction, operations, or maintenance activities at project site.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Construction direction requires on-site presence and authority

tasks.text: Inspect project sites to monitor progress and ensure conformance to design specifications and safety or sanitation standards.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical site verification against specs is human

dwas.name: Inspect facilities or sites to determine if they meet specifications or standards.

tasks.text: Compute load and grade requirements, water flow rates, or material stress factors to determine design specifications.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Estimates from specs; human validates assumptions and risk

dwas.name: Estimate technical or resource requirements for development or production projects.

tasks.text: Plan and design transportation or hydraulic systems or structures, using computer-assisted design or drawing tools.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Civil drawings need licensed engineering judgment

dwas.name: Create graphical representations of civil structures.

tasks.text: Provide technical advice to industrial or managerial personnel regarding design, construction, program modifications, or structural repairs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Proposes design changes; human validates feasibility

dwas.name: Recommend technical design or process changes to improve efficiency, quality, or performance.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Analyze survey reports, maps, drawings, blueprints, aerial photography, or other topographical or geologic data.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Evaluates technical data impact; engineer owns design

dwas.name: Evaluate technical data to determine effect on designs or plans.

tasks.text: Direct or participate in surveying to lay out installations or establish reference points, grades, or elevations to guide construction.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Field survey of land/water bodies

dwas.name: Survey land or bodies of water to measure or determine features.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Estimate quantities and cost of materials, equipment, or labor to determine project feasibility.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Operational cost estimation from data

dwas.name: Estimate operational costs.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Prepare or present public reports on topics such as bid proposals, deeds, environmental impact statements, or property and right-of-way descriptions.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Assemble proposal documents from provided content

dwas.name: Explain project details to the general public.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Design energy-efficient or environmentally sound civil structures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI proposes green features; engineer owns design decisions

dwas.name: Incorporate green features into the design of structures or facilities.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Test soils or materials to determine the adequacy and strength of foundations, concrete, asphalt, or steel.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Material characteristic testing needs physical instruments

dwas.name: Test characteristics of materials or structures.

tasks.text: Identify environmental risks and develop risk management strategies for civil engineering projects.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts technical methods; expert validates feasibility

dwas.name: Investigate the environmental impact of projects.
Develop technical methods or processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Conduct studies of traffic patterns or environmental conditions to identify engineering problems and assess potential project impact.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Impact assessment aided; site-specific data human

dwas.name: Investigate the environmental impact of projects.

tasks.text: Develop or implement engineering solutions to clean up industrial accidents or other contaminated sites.
tasks.rationale: text generation — AI drafts technical methods; expert validates feasibility

dwas.name: Develop technical methods or processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Design or engineer systems to efficiently dispose of chemical, biological, or other toxic wastes.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids emission system design; engineering validation human

dwas.name: Design systems to reduce harmful emissions.

emerging_tasks.task: Use drone technology for site surveying, inspection, and monitoring of infrastructure projects.
